brief_rationale: The trajectory has no serious or minor responsibility-chain errors. All six RC items were met: current ACS triage performed early (RC1), workspace queries attempted to reconcile records (RC2), antiplatelet medication safety emphasized repeatedly (RC3), cardiology handoff and follow-up addressed (RC4), lung nodule correctly prioritized below cardiovascular risk (RC5), and bounded safe closure achieved with teach-back (RC6). Three high-order points were completed (HO1, HO3, HO4) with meaningful trajectory impact, exceeding the two required for Perfect. Closure was safe, executable, and traceable.
